title: Hanging jar lantern
summary: A wire collar and a twine-wrapped handle turn an empty jar into a lantern for a balcony, garden or dinner table.
summary_ar: طوق من السلك ومقبض ملفوف بالخيط يحوّلان البرطمان الفارغ إلى فانوس للشرفة أو الحديقة أو مائدة العشاء.
result: a clear glass jar with a twisted wire collar under the rim and an arched twine-wrapped handle, a tea light glowing on a thin layer of sand inside
extra_materials: a cup of sand or small pebbles
steps_outline: Soak the jar in warm soapy water and peel off the label and glue
Wrap craft wire twice around the groove under the rim and twist it tight with pliers
Hook a 30 cm length of wire to both sides of the collar to form a handle
Wind twine tightly along the handle and tie it off
Pour in 2 cm of sand and set a tea light in the middle
safety: Tuck sharp wire ends flat against the glass
Use an LED tea light indoors and never leave a flame unattended
Check the jar for chips or cracks before you start

title: Windowsill herb jar
summary: A clean jar with a drainage layer of pebbles grows basil, mint or parsley on a sunny windowsill.
summary_ar: برطمان نظيف بطبقة تصريف من الحصى يزرع فيه الريحان أو النعناع أو البقدونس على نافذة مشمسة.
result: a clear glass jar showing layers of pebbles and dark potting soil, a small leafy basil plant growing out of the top
steps_outline: Wash the jar and remove the label
Add 3 cm of pebbles for drainage, then a thin layer of charcoal if you have it
Fill with potting mix up to 2 cm below the rim
Plant the seedling, press the soil gently and trim any damaged leaves
Water lightly and place it where it gets at least four hours of sun
safety: Jars have no drainage hole: water little and often so roots never sit in water
Only use a jar that held food, never one that held chemicals

title: Painted jar desk organizer
summary: Paint on the outside and a clean masked band turn a jar into a pen, brush or makeup-brush holder.
summary_ar: طلاء من الخارج مع شريط غير مطلي يحوّل البرطمان إلى حامل أقلام أو فرش.
result: a glass jar painted matte white on the outside with one clear unpainted band around the middle, holding pens and pencils
extra_materials: rubbing alcohol or vinegar to degrease
pens or brushes to fill it
steps_outline: Remove the label and wipe the outside with vinegar or alcohol so paint sticks
Mask a straight band around the jar with masking tape
Paint the outside in thin coats, letting each coat dry
Peel the tape while the last coat is slightly soft for a clean edge
Tie twine around the neck as a finishing touch
safety: Paint the outside only; this jar is for desk items, not food
Work on newspaper and wear gloves or old clothes

title: Twine-wrapped bottle vase
summary: Natural twine wound around a bottle makes a rustic vase for dried or fresh flowers.
summary_ar: خيط القنّب الملفوف حول الزجاجة يصنع مزهرية ريفية للزهور المجففة أو الطازجة.
result: a glass bottle with its lower two thirds tightly wrapped in natural brown twine, the clear glass neck left bare, holding a few dried flowers
steps_outline: Soak off the label and dry the bottle completely
Glue the end of the twine near the base
Wind the twine upwards in tight rows, adding a dot of glue every few turns
Stop below the shoulder, cut the twine and glue the end down
Fill with water or dried stems
safety: Keep glue off your fingers and let it cure before adding water

title: Jar soap dispenser
summary: A pump from an empty soap bottle fitted through the jar's metal lid makes a sturdy refillable dispenser.
summary_ar: مضخة من عبوة صابون فارغة تُركّب في غطاء البرطمان المعدني لتصنع موزّعًا متينًا قابلًا لإعادة التعبئة.
result: a clear glass jar filled with liquid hand soap, its metal lid fitted with a white pump dispenser
extra_materials: pump top from an empty soap bottle
steps_outline: Mark the centre of the lid and place it on a wooden board
Tap a nail through the centre, then widen the hole with a screwdriver until the pump tube fits
Push the pump through and trim the tube to reach the bottom of the jar
Glue around the pump collar and let it cure
Fill with soap and screw the lid on
safety: Wear work gloves: the punched lid edge is sharp
Hold the lid on a board, never in your hand, while hammering

title: Succulent jar terrarium
summary: Layers of gravel, charcoal and cactus soil in a wide jar hold a small low-care garden of succulents.
summary_ar: طبقات من الحصى والفحم وتربة الصبار في برطمان واسع تحتضن حديقة صغيرة من النباتات العصارية قليلة العناية.
result: a wide clear glass jar with visible layers of white gravel and dark soil, three small green succulents and a few decorative stones on top
steps_outline: Clean and dry the jar inside and out
Add 3 cm of gravel, then a thin layer of charcoal
Spoon in cactus soil to about a third of the jar's height
Plant the succulents with a spoon, largest first, and press the soil around them
Top with small stones and mist lightly
safety: Leave the jar open: closed jars trap moisture and rot succulents

title: Bottle fairy-light lamp
summary: A string of battery LED fairy lights fed into a clean bottle makes a soft table lamp with no wiring.
summary_ar: سلسلة أضواء LED صغيرة تعمل بالبطارية داخل زجاجة نظيفة تصنع مصباحًا هادئًا دون أي توصيلات كهربائية.
result: a clear glass bottle filled with a coil of warm white LED fairy lights glowing inside, twine wrapped around the neck
extra_materials: battery LED fairy lights (cork-style or with a small battery box)
steps_outline: Remove the label and dry the bottle inside
Feed the fairy lights into the neck a little at a time
Leave the battery box outside or use a cork-style light that plugs the neck
Wrap twine around the neck to hide the wire
safety: Use LED lights only: they stay cool inside the glass

title: Wall-mounted jar organizer
summary: Three jars held to a sanded board with hose clamps store cotton pads, brushes or screws on the wall.
summary_ar: ثلاثة برطمانات مثبتة على لوح خشبي مصنفر بمشابك الخراطيم لتخزين القطن أو الفرش أو البراغي على الحائط.
result: a sanded natural wood board mounted on a wall with three clear glass jars held upright by metal hose clamps, filled with cotton pads and brushes
extra_materials: 3 hose clamps sized to the jars
steps_outline: Sand the board smooth and wipe off the dust
Mark three evenly spaced jar positions
Drill pilot holes and screw each hose clamp to the board
Slide the jars in and tighten the clamps just enough to hold them
Drill the wall, fit plugs and screw the board up, checking it is level
safety: Wear safety glasses when drilling and a dust mask while sanding
Check for pipes and cables before drilling a wall
Tighten clamps gently: too much pressure can crack glass

title: Labelled pantry jars
summary: Matching clean jars with hand-written labels keep rice, lentils, spices and snacks airtight and easy to see.
summary_ar: برطمانات نظيفة متناسقة بملصقات مكتوبة باليد تحفظ الأرز والعدس والبهارات بإحكام وتسهّل رؤيتها.
result: a row of clean clear glass jars with their original lids, filled with rice, lentils and pasta, each with a small hand-written kraft paper label
extra_materials: cooking oil and baking soda to lift old glue
steps_outline: Soak the jars, then rub off glue with a paste of oil and baking soda
Wash jars and lids in hot soapy water and dry them completely
Cut labels to the same size and write the contents and date
Stick the labels on the outside, straight and at the same height
Fill with dry food and close tightly
safety: Only reuse jars that held food, and check the lid seal is intact
Dry jars completely before filling to prevent mold
